changes.text: Switched-off level chips (`aria-pressed="false"`) keep AA contrast: they use `--ss-fg-muted` text and a dashed border instead of `opacity: 0.45`.
The `role="log"` scroller has `tabindex="0"`, so keyboard users can focus and scroll it.

The default empty state is plain text (`.empty` with `.empty-title` and `.empty-msg`) instead of an `EmptyState` with `role="status"`, so the message is no longer announced twice inside the live region.
The toolbar chips, the search field and the "Jump to bottom" button read `--ss-chip-py` for vertical padding instead of `--ss-badge-py`. The values are the same, so rendering is unchanged.

The viewport height and column widths are size-aware tokens: `--ss-log-min-h`, `--ss-log-max-h`, `--ss-log-t-w` and `--ss-log-lvl-w`. The `md` values equal the former fixed pixels; `sm` and `lg` now scale.
Controlled `lines` prop with the exported `LogLine` and `LogLevel` types, and `maxLines` (default `30`) to cap the buffer. In a line, `id`, `t` and `svc` are optional.
The built-in random stream is a demo that runs only when `lines` is not passed; the new `demo` prop turns it on or off and `live` stays as an alias.
Controls toolbar (`controls`, default `true`) with per-level filter chips, a text filter, a wrap toggle, copy and clear. The `toolbar` snippet replaces it and `wrap` sets the initial wrapping.
Follow-tail: the log scrolls to new lines only while you are at the bottom, and a "Jump to bottom" button appears when you scroll up.
The log region has `role="log"`, an `ariaLabel` prop (default `Log output`) and an `announce` prop (`off`, `polite` or `assertive`) that sets `aria-live`.
Empty state with an `empty` snippet to replace it, and a `loading` prop that shows a connecting indicator and sets `aria-busy`.

Markup: lines now sit in `.viewport` > `.scroll` inside `.ss-logs`, the message has a `.msg` class, and the root has a border. Colours come from tokens: `--ss-code-bg` replaces the hardcoded `#0a0a0a`, levels read `--ss-log-info`, `--ss-log-warn`, `--ss-log-err` and `--ss-log-ok`.
Styles are scoped inside the component; the global `theme.css` no longer carries the `.ss-logs` rules.
`size` prop (`sm`, `md` or `lg`) that inherits the global size when unset; the root carries `data-size-variant`.
The root class is `ss-logs` (was `hub-logs`), and the tokens it reads are `--ss-*` (were `--hs-*`).
New component: a terminal-style log viewer that shows timestamped lines with a level and a service tag. It streams built-in sample lines while `live` is true and takes `initialLines` as the seed.
